must_entail: Account code 6100 is used for travel costs.

must_entail: The close period is locked on the 5th workday.

must_entail: US-0984 is authorized to post records during close.

must_entail: An invoice must be paid within 30 days of the three-way match.

must_entail: A meal expense of $75 or less per meal is reimbursable.

extra.name: live_alcohol_is_not_reimbursable
extra.query: Is alcohol reimbursable on an expense claim?
must_entail: Alcohol is not reimbursable.

must_entail: An employee must attach a receipt for an expense exceeding $25.

extra.name: live_post_lock_no_adjustments

must_entail: No adjustments or new entries may be made after the close period is locked.

extra.name: live_account_2100_stays_in_the_table

stress.name: stress_live_wording_of_the_replaced_rule
stress.query: What invoice amount needs finance manager approval?
must_entail: An invoice of $10,000 or more requires finance manager approval.

stress.name: stress_ten_thousand_paraphrase
stress.query: Who has to sign off before we pay a vendor bill of ten thousand dollars or more?
must_entail: An invoice of $10,000 or more requires finance manager approval.

stress.name: stress_clerk_can_release_under_the_limit
stress.query: Can the AP clerk release an invoice below the approval threshold without the finance manager?
must_entail: An invoice below this threshold may be released by the AP clerk without further approval.

stress.name: stress_hold_does_not_start_the_clock
stress.query: Does an invoice on hold start the payment countdown?
must_contain: does not begin the payment period
must_entail: An invoice on hold does not begin the payment period until the discrepancy is resolved.

stress.name: stress_no_po_is_unmatched
stress.query: What happens to an invoice that arrives with no purchase order?
must_entail: An invoice received without an associated purchase order is recorded as unmatched.

stress.name: stress_send_back_to_vendor
stress.query: Who can send an invoice back to the vendor when approval is still missing near the payment deadline?
must_entail: The finance manager may direct that the invoice be returned to the vendor.

stress.name: stress_current_version_is_the_payment_rule
stress.query: Which accounts payable version is the current rule for payment decisions?
must_entail: This version is the current rule for payment decisions.

stress.name: stress_retired_amount
stress.query: Before the current handbook, how large did an invoice have to be before a finance manager approved it?
must_entail: An invoice of $7,500 or more requires finance manager approval.

stress.name: stress_pay_window_old_and_new

An invoice must be paid within 30 days of the three-way match.

must_entail: A meal expense exceeding $75 requires the approval of the employee's supervisor.

stress.name: stress_cap_is_not_a_daily_total
stress.query: Does the meal cap apply to the whole day or to each meal?
must_contain: not to an employee's total daily meal spend
must_entail: The meal cap applies per individual meal, not to the total daily meal spend.

stress.name: stress_expense_clock_is_from_the_incurred_date
stress.query: How many days does an employee have to submit a claim after spending the money?
must_contain: 30 days of the date the expense was incurred
must_entail: An employee shall submit an expense claim within 30 days of the date the expense was incurred.

stress.name: stress_late_claim_needs_supervisor
stress.query: What if an employee files an expense after the submission window?

must_entail: A claim submitted after this period requires the approval of the employee's supervisor.

stress.name: stress_missing_purpose_is_returned

must_entail: A claim missing an itemized business purpose is returned to the employee.

stress.name: stress_meals_cannot_be_pooled
stress.query: Can three meals on a travel day be claimed as one pile?
must_entail: Each meal stands alone.

stress.name: stress_drink_comes_off_the_bill
stress.query: Can a drink stay on the bill if the employee mostly ate food?
must_entail: Take the drink off before you submit or the whole claim comes back.

stress.name: stress_close_does_not_reopen_expenses
stress.query: Can a late expense claim from last month ride along with this month's close?
must_contain: does not reopen an expense window
must_entail: Close does not reopen an expense window.

stress.name: stress_cash_code_is_not_the_travel_code
stress.query: What account code is cash at close, and which job posts it?
must_entail: Account code 1000-CASH is cash.
US-0001 posts the cash account.

stress.name: stress_payroll_must_log_before_lock_day
stress.query: When must the payroll accrual be in the books at close?
must_entail: Account code 5000-PAY is the payroll accrual.

stress.name: stress_airfare_code_lives_in_the_table

must_entail: Account code 6100 is used for travel costs.

stress.name: stress_late_travel_does_not_reopen_the_month

must_entail: A late travel report does not reopen the month.

stress.name: stress_no_weekend_lock

must_entail: There is no weekend lock.

must_entail: After lock, a wrong code is treated in the following period.
